en:
I still...don't believe it...
Is that video real?

It could have been edited to make it
*look* like Kaito was killed by the press.
Damn right!

There's no way this Luminary of the Stars
would die that easily!
K-Kaito again!?

Would you have liked it better if it turned
out like that? Ah-haha, you wish!
<CLT=cltMIND>Ah!

Like I said, that footage isn't edited at all.
It recorded the event completely as is.

Kaito was crushed! His bones went crunch, 
and his organs went squish!

*huuurp*... I remembered the video...
And all my bittersweet memories of him...

Hold those memories within you...or
they'll just escape as sour vomit.

But we all know Kokichi loves to lie.
And that he's a <CLT=cltSTRONG>Remnant of Despair<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

That leads me to believe there's something
he's not telling us about that video.

I don't think that video showed the murder
at all! All we saw was a living body!
A...living body?

Nee-heehee... I don't blame you for not
believing it.

It's hard to believe a smug idiot like Kaito
got squished like a bug, right?
But your lie won't work here, Shuichi.

No, what you said isn't even a lie!
It's just wishful thinking!
<CLT=cltMIND>You're wrong, Kokichi.

<CLT=cltSTRONG>My emotional reaction<CLT=cltMIND> is the <CLT=cltSTRONG>lie<CLT=cltMIND>.
I put on this act to get what I want from you.

<CLT=cltMIND>I know that these class trials demand
that someone dies. I'm prepared for that.

<CLT=cltMIND>My intuition is telling me there's something
wrong with that video. It was shot for a reason.

<CLT=cltMIND>Is there a hint in what Kokichi has
said? Some key to the mystery?
Isn't this enough? Kokichi is the culprit.

He brought the evidence and even
confessed to the murder.

That doesn't make sense! Not even Kokichi
would do something that stupid!

Is common sense going to work here?
On the Remnants of Despair, I mean.
...Oh! A hit! I got a hit!

Shuichi, I got a hit containing some important
info!
A hit?

The word "<CLT=cltSTRONG>living<CLT=cltNORMAL>" stuck out to me, so I ran
a search for that word in my memory bank.
And...there was one hit.
Uh, do you mean...you remembered something?
What important info was in your search hit?

The <CLT=cltSTRONG>living organism detector<CLT=cltNORMAL> that
we found when we investigated the press.

The existence of this detector refutes
the very premise of this discusison.
Of course! The <CLT=cltSTRONG>safety function<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
The video does *not* show Kaito's murder!

The <CLT=cltSTRONG>safety function<CLT=cltNORMAL> would make it impossible
to kill Kaito with the press!
A safety function?
Yes, it was written on the <CLT=cltSTRONG>safety precautions<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

The hydraulic press will <CLT=cltSTRONG>automatically stop<CLT=cltNORMAL> if
its infrared sensor <CLT=cltSTRONG>detects a living organism<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

So the hydraulic press won't move at 
all if there's a living person under it?

Which is why it couldn't have been used
to kill Kaito!

Which means, it's more likely that Kaito was
crushed after being killed by some other means.

So what we saw in that video...
He was already dead by then?

But you could disable the infrared sensor of
the safety function with an Electrobomb.

No, I don't think Kokichi would
use an Electrobomb for that purpose.

It would have taken down the hangar's alarm
system and the Exisals' remote control.

It would've put Kokichi at a significant
disadvantage.

But you can't be too sure I wouldn't do that...
I'm the type who would do anything for fun.

Also, we don't have any evidence of a different
murder method other than the hydraulic pr—

No, we do. I have a plausible theory
for the murder.
...What?

<CLT=cltMIND>Yes, there is a clue that suggests
the victim was killed before being crushed.

<CLT=cltMIND>I found it somewhere around
the hydraulic press...

There was a crossbow in the bathroom.
Perhaps the victim was killed there?

Then there should've been evidence of the body
being carried to the hydraulic press.
Was there any evidence?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

There were three arrows in the bathroom.
Perhaps the victim was killed there?

Then there should've been evidence of the body
being carried to the hydraulic press.
Was there any evidence?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

There was an empty bottle
in the bathroom...
with "poison" written on the label.

There are various kinds of poisons, and they
aren't all necessarily fatal...

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

You talked all big and now you're quiet?
...You disgust me.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
And? What does that prove?

If Kaito was killed by some other means, his
body would've been moved to the press...

It is unfortunate that my allergy kept
me from investigating more thoroughly...

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

What clue suggests that the cause of death
was not the crushing by the hydraulic press?

There was a swipe pattern <CLT=cltSTRONG>bloodstain<CLT=cltNORMAL>
in the hangar, suggesting a body was dragged.

The bloodstain goes from the bathroom
all the way to the press.

Oh! That was the restroom where
Kaito was being held, wasn't it!?

Bloodstains were also found inside the
bathroom. That can't be coincidence.

So Kaito was killed in the restroom,
then dragged to the press and crushed!?
...If the bloodstain even was Kaito's.
What?

We only guessed that Kaito was killed in
the bathroom...

Since his body was crushed, we'll never know
if Kaito died some other way.

<CLT=cltMIND>We might not be able to
examine the body, but...

<CLT=cltMIND>we do have evidence that
suggests a cause of death.
Kaito was killed by...something...

Hmm... If the cause of death is different,
then perhaps it is related to Kaito somehow.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

Looking closely at Kaito's clothes
will give us the cause of death.

True... Kaito's sleeve is the only lead we
have to search for clues...
That's not much to go off of, though...

Were there any others clues that could be
found on his sleeve?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

Perhaps this bloodstain can
tell us the cause of death...

Unfortunately, we can't determine a cause
of death just by looking at Kaito's blood.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
...See? There's no way to know.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

What piece of evidence is
linked to the cause of death?

The <CLT=cltSTRONG>small hole<CLT=cltNORMAL> on the sleeve of Kaito's coat
is the key to his cause of death.
S-Small hole...?

No, no, no! There is no way that hole's
got anything to do with a weapon!

I'll hit you with my "Everything You
Buy Will Go on Sale the Next Day" curse!

Himiko, what's wrong? Why are you 
freaking out all of a sudden?
Um... I'm not freaking out...

I'm just saying...it's impossible
for the weapon to be that small.

<CLT=cltMIND>No...it's not impossible.
I can show you.

<CLT=cltMIND>The weapon that left that small
hole in Kaito's sleeve...
The arrows in the bathroom...

What can you do with just an arrow!?
Are you saying they stabbed him with it?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

If you really think about it, there's no 
way a weapon like that exists, r-right?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

Th-There's no way they made a 
hole with that!
Hmph!

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

What weapon left the small hole
in Kaito's sleeve?

I believe the weapon was the crossbow
found in the bathroom.
Nyeh!?

A crossbow arrow would certainly leave
a hole that small.

Can we then conclude that Kaito was shot
with that crossbow?

If so, that crossbow just might be the actual
murder weapon used to kill Kaito—

I-I see! It's so surprising that a
crossbow was the murder weapon!
Seriously, Himiko...what's wrong?

She probably needs to pee.
Anywaaay, about Kaito getting shot...

If that was his cause of death, then I
wonder who shot him with the crossbow.

Well, I already know!
But I won't tell youuuu!
He's just...playing with us...
Then let's show him that playtime is over.

Let's show him that the students of Hope's
Peak Academy will never submit to despair!
Hope...? Despair...?
